translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's Buying a Ticket to Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to cut their losses because they see a stop-loss as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Look at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and that small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've seen are more decisive than anyone when they're wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself,
“This is the price of admission, not a verdict.”

title: Ethereum Glamsterdam Test Delayed Over Security Concerns
subTitle:
The Ethereum Glamsterdam test has been officially pushed back after security developers flagged potential risks to existing smart contracts.

It seems like the developers behind the network are taking a 'better safe than sorry' approach this time around. While everyone loves a smooth upgrade, nobody wants to wake up to a broken contract, so hitting the brakes on the Glamsterdam test was a prudent move. It is a bit like realizing you forgot your keys right as you lock the front door—annoying, but definitely better than being locked out entirely. 😅

Security researchers pointed out that the current iteration could inadvertently disrupt how existing contracts function on the mainnet. Since Ethereum is the backbone for so many decentralized applications, the team decided that rushing into this test phase just wasn't worth the headache

Why it matters 💡
Keep an eye on official developer updates for a new timeline on the test. It is a great time to brush up on how these network upgrades generally function, as it helps you understand the technical health of the ecosystem beyond just the daily market noise.

📰 Why haven’t crypto giants fallen amid internet vulnerabilities? What does growing regulatory concern really mean?

A serious security vulnerability recently emerged on the internet, but major crypto firms such as Coinbase and BitGo say they were unaffected. That doesn’t mean the crypto industry can breathe easy, though—the separate eMudhra vulnerability can still be exploited, so users need to strengthen their security measures. The companies’ responses and regulators’ cautious stance could make the market more uneasy in the short term.

Why does this news matter?
This PHP vulnerability has an extremely wide reach, affecting not only the crypto sector but the traditional internet as well. Crypto companies can probably say they were unaffected because they have stricter security isolation measures in place. But this reveals a deeper issue: although the crypto industry is technologically advanced, it may still rely on the same vulnerable approaches to basic software security as the traditional internet. Regulators’ calls for caution at this moment are no coincidence—they put the security framework of the entire industry under scrutiny.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin and Ethereum may continue to be weighed down by broader market sentiment. Cyberattacks tend to make investors think of security risks at exchanges or in wallets, which can prompt outflows. Over the long term, if the industry broadly raises its security standards, that could boost confidence in the entire ecosystem. But in the short term, regulatory pressure and user concerns will combine to make a strong market rebound difficult. There are few comparable past events, but the 2017 Bitfinex malware incident showed that even leading institutions cannot completely avoid security risks.

Trading perspective
💡 I think BTC and ETH will both struggle to escape the broader market’s downward pressure in the short term. However, the cautious statements from leading institutions may actually suggest that they have more robust security systems in place—a rare source of certainty amid market panic. If a larger-scale attack on traditional internet companies occurs in the future, this assessment no longer holds.

最近互联网上爆发了严重的安全漏洞，但 Coinbase、Bitgo 等加密货币大厂声称自己没事。不过，这并不意味着加密行业可以松口气——另一个叫 eMudhra 的漏洞依然能被利用，用户还是得加强安全防范。这些公司的回应和监管的谨慎态度，可能让市场短期内更不安。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次 PHP 漏洞影响范围极广，不仅是加密领域，传统互联网都深受其害。加密货币公司之所以能声称没事，大概率是因为他们做了更严格的安全隔离措施。但这背后暴露出一个问题：加密行业虽然技术先进，但在基础软件安全上，可能还在沿用传统互联网的脆弱模式。监管机构此时呼吁谨慎，不是空穴来风，而是对整个行业安全体系的拷问。

对市场的影响
短期来看，比特币和以太坊可能会继续受到大盘情绪的拖累。因为网络攻击事件总是能让投资者联想到交易所或钱包的安全风险，从而引发资金流出。长期看，如果行业普遍提升安全标准，可能会提升整个生态的公信力，但短期内，监管压力和用户担忧会形成合力，让市场难以出现强劲反弹。历史类似事件不多，但 2017 年的 Bitfinex 恶意软件事件显示，即使是头部机构，也难以完全避免安全风险。

操作思路
💡 我认为短期内 BTC 和 ETH 都很难摆脱大盘的调整压力，但头部机构的谨慎表态，反而可能暗示他们有更完善的安全体系，这是市场恐慌中难得的确定性。如果未来出现更大规模的传统互联网公司被攻击事件，这个判断就作废。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

Hey, everyone! After eight years of crypto trading, what I’ve ended up with is a simple, no-frills approach.#ETH 

I entered the crypto market in 2018. From 2020 to 2022, my account reached eight figures. I made money, and I gave it back, too. After seeing so much, I’ve come to believe one thing more and more: the people who manage to keep their money often aren’t the ones making the cleverest moves, but the ones with the simplest discipline.

I call my approach “30-40-30 position building.” Put simply, split your capital into three parts instead of putting it all in at once.

Step one: Start with 30%.
If you have 120,000 in capital, put 36,000 in first. No matter how promising a coin looks, let the market show you the way first. If you’re wrong about the direction, you still have room to maneuver. That’s not being timid—it’s leaving yourself a way out.

Step two: Add 40% once things are confirmed.
Wait for a pullback to a key support level, and add in stages once it holds. A price drop doesn’t automatically mean something is cheap. If support breaks, don’t rush to buy more. I used to make the mistake of “buying more as it kept falling.” It took me a while to realize that blindly averaging down is one of the easiest ways to turn a small mistake into a big one.

Step three: Add the final 30% in line with the trend.
Wait for a real breakout above key resistance and for the trend to take shape, then put in the last portion. If the price action doesn’t look right, reduce your position or cut your losses according to plan—don’t stubbornly hold on. In-Depth Analysis

- The market is still digesting Wednesday’s news that the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points
- The risk premium on cryptocurrencies remains relatively high compared with traditional assets

In the short term, ETF outflows will increase selling pressure, especially on highly correlated assets like BTC. The long-term impact, however, depends on whether the outflows persist. 📰 Futu suddenly opens accounts to Hong Kong professional investors—why did BNB go up instead?

Futu announced that it would allow Hong Kong professional investors to deposit and withdraw BNB. Put simply, this helps Hong Kong crypto investors manage the movement of their funds. Hong Kong is the world’s second-largest crypto hub, so this move is like opening a new gateway to the pool of capital, directly boosting BNB’s liquidity and potentially attracting more high-net-worth investors.

Why does this news matter?
The main reason behind Futu’s move is that Hong Kong’s crypto market lacks an officially recognized platform for large-scale digital asset trading. The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission previously introduced guidelines for licensing virtual asset trading platforms, but offshore platforms like Futu still dominate. Futu has little chance of obtaining a Hong Kong license, so it can only tap into Hong Kong’s capital indirectly. This means:
1. Hong Kong professional investors—such as hedge funds and family offices—now have a compliant channel for trading BNB. They no longer need to route transactions through Singapore, Europe, or the US, improving capital costs and efficiency.
2. BNB’s ability to attract capital in Hong Kong will increase, given that Hong Kong is one of Asia’s wealth hubs.

Market impact
Although the news itself is neutral, it could boost sentiment around BNB in the short term. It reflects the crypto market’s ambitions for global expansion, but the key question is how well this plays out over the long term. If Futu really manages to secure a Hong Kong license, that could provide medium-term support for BNB’s price. In the short term, the main impact is that more Hong Kong capital may flow through BNB, benefiting liquidity.

Trading strategy
💡 BNB’s intraday volatility may increase, but over the medium to long term, it stands to benefit from the institutionalization of the market. One thing to watch is the flow of funds around BNB’s $750 level. If Hong Kong’s license approval process progresses faster than expected, this level could be pushed higher. However, keep in mind that tighter global regulation could weaken this positive effect.

📰 Futu突然给香港专业投资者开户，为什么BNB反而涨了？

Futu宣布允许香港专业投资者存取BNB，这事儿说白了就是帮香港的加密玩家搞定了资金流转。香港可是全球第二大加密中心，这波操作等于给资金池开了个新闸口，对BNB流动性直接是加分项，可能吸引更多高净值投资者跑来玩。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Futu此举的根本原因在于香港加密市场缺个官方认可的、大额的数字货币交易平台。香港证监会之前搞了《虚拟资产交易平台牌照指引》，但像富途这种境外平台还是占主导。Futu想拿下香港牌照又没戏，只能通过这种间接方式收割香港的钱。这意味着：
1. 香港专业投资者（比如对冲基金、家族办公室）有了合规的BNB操作渠道，不用再绕道新加坡或欧美，资金成本和效率都提升
2. BNB在香港的资金虹吸效应会增强，毕竟香港是亚洲财富中心之一

对市场的影响
虽然消息本身中性，但短期内对BNB的情绪有提振作用。这反映了加密市场全球化布局的野心，但关键看长期落地效果。如果Futu真能把香港牌照搞定，对BNB价格有中期支撑意义。短期看，主要影响是香港的资金流入会更多经过BNB这个载体，利好流动性。

操作思路
💡 BNB的日内波动会放大，但中长期看是受益于机构化进程的。值得关注的点是BNB $750附近的资金面。如果未来香港牌照审批进度超预期，这个位置可能被推高。但要注意，如果全球监管趋严，这个利好会被削弱。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earns 50% on a win, and loses 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term math: 60% × 50% − 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
which looks like positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% drawdown, and you’d need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. This is the Gambler’s Ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Keep the same strategy, but only use 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row cost you 18%—hardly a knockout blow,
and you still get the long-term expected return. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has. The difference is life or death.

The biggest takeaway today: Ethereum has hit pause on the Glamsterdam hard fork, which was scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26. $ETH 
The problem isn’t a coding error; it’s a blind spot in the rules. EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 aim to optimize Gas pricing, but they could change how Gas is refunded after failed external calls. In an extreme scenario, a malicious caller could use just-not-enough Gas to trick a contract into permanently recording a failed operation—potentially locking users out of retrying a transaction or claiming what they’re owed.
ChainSecurity has already found 13 real-world cases in existing contracts and is working with the project teams on responsible disclosure. The names have not been made public yet. The Ethereum Foundation has also confirmed that replaying transactions on mainnet showed that a small number of contracts could be affected. Most can be fixed by raising the Gas limit, but contracts with hard-coded Gas assumptions won’t be so easy to fix.
The upgrade was originally planned for mainnet in early December; now the timeline is up
in the air again. The plan to raise Hoodi’s Gas limit to 200 million has also been delayed. Nodes and validators should follow the update announcements; ordinary mainnet users and $ETH  holders don’t need to do anything for now.
My take: upgrades need to move faster, but not at the cost of the security of existing applications. Catching this kind of “rule-level side effect” during the testnet phase is far cheaper than dealing with a permanent failure after mainnet launch. Trading short-term uncertainty for fewer problems down the road is worth it.

📰 Why Does Bitcoin’s Midterm Pullback Look More Like Its Own Cycle Than Election Aftermath?

Bitcoin’s recent price decline is not entirely the result of the U.S. midterm elections, some analysts say. Instead, it looks more like a cyclical correction in line with Bitcoin’s own patterns. This view holds that BTC’s internal market dynamics explain its current price action better than external political events, highlighting the sources of volatility unique to cryptocurrencies.

Why does this news matter?
Bitcoin is currently in what is traditionally considered a cyclical correction phase. Historically, BTC’s price action has tended to follow certain cyclical patterns, such as a substantial correction after the peak of each major cycle. This view emphasizes that while political events can affect market sentiment, they are generally unlikely to fully dictate the price of a highly speculative asset like Bitcoin. This means the current pullback is more likely a normal process of the market absorbing profit-taking and adjusting the balance between supply and demand than a sudden political shock.

Market impact
If Bitcoin’s own cycle is confirmed as the main driver, the pullback may not change the medium-term uptrend. The key is whether the depth and duration of the correction reach historical support levels, and whether there are sufficient signs of capital inflows. If the correction is too deep (for example, falling below $80K), or is accompanied by negative data such as significant whale outflows or changes in miner behavior, the cyclical-correction assessment may need to be revised. For now, at $81,650, the price remains relatively high, and the pullback looks more like a normal correction.

Trading approach
Bitcoin appears to be in a cyclical correction phase, a normal process of risk being absorbed for bulls. If the pullback attracts new long-term capital, the decline may be short-lived. However, this assessment assumes that fundamentals and institutional interest remain stable. If negative events occur, such as tighter global regulation, a series of major exchange failures, or a sudden deterioration in the macroeconomic outlook, the cyclical-correction assessment would no longer hold.

HSBC’s HKD Stablecoin Launches｜ETH Not Yet Connected｜Wait for On-Chain Evidence and Price Confirmation

My stance is cautious: a bank-issued stablecoin is an important development in payment and compliance infrastructure, but just because it’s trending doesn’t mean we should count it as new transaction volume for Ethereum. Today, HSBC Hong Kong officially announced that its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, RedCoin (RCHKD), has launched on PayMe by HSBC, under a license and supervision from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. The official announcement says that PayMe’s more than 3.3 million users will be able to activate wallets over the coming days, enabling person-to-person transfers and payments at more than 100,000 merchants. There are two timing caveats here: a launch does not mean all users have access today; and the plan to bring it to HSBC Hong Kong’s mobile banking app later this year for subscriptions to tokenized investment products does not mean it is already live.

I checked HSBC’s press release and the HKMA’s register of licensed issuers from the same day. They confirm the issuance and licensing, but do not say that RedCoin is issued or settled on Ethereum mainnet or any other public blockchain, nor do they provide an on-chain address. So the real value of the trending topic is that it offers a chance to see whether traditional banks are moving stablecoins from concept to everyday payments—not a basis for concluding that ETH fees are about to rise. There are several steps between this and any impact on ETH: actual usage by users and merchants, whether the bank’s platform opens up cross-chain or public-chain interfaces, and whether settlement takes place through Ethereum or its layer-2 networks. If transfers remain within a closed application, payment growth could be substantial while direct value capture by ETH may not increase in tandem.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,396, with a rolling 24-hour low of $2,357 and a high of $2,416. The price is in the middle of that range: there has been no confirmed breakout, and this movement cannot be attributed to the HSBC news. I would first watch to see if it can hold above $2,416 intraday, then look for expanding volume and confirmation from other major coins. If this is just a brief news-driven spike, the risk of a pullback is more important than the potential gain from chasing the price. $2,357 is the immediate support level; if it breaks, the overall risk appetite needs to be reassessed. These prices are from a quote snapshot and will change with the market; they are not guaranteed execution prices.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t buy just because of the RedCoin news. I’d only consider a small spot long after specific conditions are met, with a position size of no more than 3% of total capital and no leverage. I would consider entering in stages only if ETH holds above $2,416, retests it without breaking below, and volume expands. I’d take half off near the first target of $2,450, then reduce further or close the entire position near the second target of $2,490. If, after entry, the price falls below $2,390 and fails to recover quickly, I’d exit with a stop-loss as planned. If it first breaks below $2,357, the entry conditions are invalidated and I’d stay out. More fundamentally, the thesis would be invalidated if subsequent official information still provides no evidence of public-chain settlement, while the market prices it as ETH on-chain revenue. I wouldn’t add to a position based on an unverified narrative. Separately verifying bank innovation and whether ETH benefits is the most important trading discipline in this case.

Sources: HSBC Hong Kong’s official press release dated October 23; the HKMA’s register of licensed issuers. Market data: Kraken ETH/USD snapshot at the time of writing. #HSBCBeginsPhasedRolloutOfHKDStablecoinRedCoin #ETH

content:
汇丰港元稳定币落地｜ETH暂未接入｜先等链上证据与价格确认

我的态度偏谨慎：银行发行稳定币是支付与合规基础设施的重要进展，但不能因为它上了热榜，就把它直接算成以太坊的新增交易量。今天汇丰香港正式宣布，港元稳定币RedCoin（RCHKD）在PayMe by HSBC推出，由香港金管局发牌监管。官方说，PayMe逾330万用户将在未来数日陆续能够启用钱包，可进行个人之间转账及向逾10万商户付款。这里有两个时间边界：推出不等于所有用户今天已开通；今年稍后拟进入汇丰香港手机银行、用于代币化投资产品申购，也不是此刻已经上线。

我核对了汇丰当天新闻稿与金管局持牌发行人名册。它们能证明发行和牌照事实，却没有说明RedCoin在以太坊主网或任何公链发行、结算，也没有给出链上地址。所以热榜话题的真正价值，是观察传统银行是否把稳定币从概念推入日常支付，而非据此推导ETH手续费马上增长。对ETH的传导至少隔着几层：用户与商户的真实使用量、银行平台是否开放跨链或公链接口、结算是否经过以太坊或其二层网络。若仍是封闭应用内流转，支付增长可能很大，ETH直接价值捕获却未必同步。

市场已如何反应？写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2396美元，滚动24小时低点2357、高点2416，价格处在区间中部，既非有效突破，也不能把这段波动归因于汇丰消息。我会先看日内能否站稳2416，再看成交与其他主流币是否共振；若只是消息刺激的短暂上冲，冲高回落的风险比追价收益更值得重视。2357是眼前的防守位，跌破后还要重新评估整体风险偏好。以上价位取自报价快照，会随市场变化，不是保证成交的价格。

如果是我自己交易，现在不因RedCoin消息直接追多，方向只考虑条件触发后的轻仓现货多单，计划仓位不超过总资金3%，不用杠杆。只有ETH在2416美元上方维持并回踩不破、同时看到成交扩张，我才考虑分批入场；第一目标2450美元附近先减半，第二目标2490美元附近再减或全部平仓。若入场后跌回2390美元下方且无法迅速收复，按计划止损离场；若先跌破2357美元，则入场条件作废，空仓等待。更根本的推翻条件，是官方后续仍无公链结算证据、而市场却把它当作ETH链上收入定价，我不会为未经证实的叙事加仓。把银行创新与ETH受益分开验证，才是这条消息最重要的交易纪律。

来源：汇丰香港10月23日官方新闻稿、香港金管局持牌发行人名册；行情为Kraken ETH/USD写稿快照。#HSBCBeginsPhasedRolloutOfHKDStablecoinRedCoin #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.content:
Starting December 3, cross-border crypto transfers by South Koreans will enter the “monthly reporting era”: under the revised Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, the Bank of Korea will require users with records of cross-border transfers to report their virtual asset holdings monthly.

This is the first concrete measure to follow yesterday’s revision of the Foreign Exchange Act. The path is clear: first bring cross-border crypto transfers into monthly reporting, then, alongside the classification of stablecoins as “payment instruments,” turn on-chain cross-border fund flows from “invisible” to “visible every month.”

What this means for ordinary users: 1) South Korean users who withdraw funds from domestic exchanges to overseas platforms, or use stablecoins for cross-border remittances, will have their activity included in monthly reports; 2) exchanges will collect more KYC data in line with the central bank’s requirements, lowering expectations of privacy; 3) this also reflects a broader trend in Asian regulation—Hong Kong and Singapore are focusing on institutional pilots, while South Korea is starting with individuals’ fund flows.

Next to watch: the implementation details for the first monthly report, and whether the reporting threshold will be “report any activity on record” or tiered by transaction amount.

#BankOfKoreaToRequireMonthlyCrossBorderCryptoReports #BTC #ETH

title: 交易心理 | 市场情绪周期：从怀疑到狂喜的六幕剧
subTitle:
每一轮行情的剧本几乎一样：
① 怀疑期：涨了几天，没人信，都在喊反弹出货。
② 认同期：创了新高，分析师开始翻多，散户半信半疑上车。
③ 兴奋期：连续拉涨，群里开始晒收益，你开始怕踏空。
④ 狂喜期：朋友圈都在讨论币，出租车司机荐币，杠杆率飙高。
⑤ 否认期：开始下跌，所有人说是「健康回调，上车机会」。
⑥ 恐慌期：连续暴跌，割肉声一片——而下一轮的种子就埋在这里。

对照一下你现在处在哪一幕。赚大钱的机会在①和⑥，亏大钱的位置在

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script is almost the same in every market cycle:
① Skepticism phase: prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it; everyone’s calling it a rebound to sell into.
② Acceptance phase: prices hit a new high, analysts start turning bullish, and retail investors hesitantly buy in.
③ Excitement phase: prices keep surging, people in the group chat start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria phase: everyone’s talking about crypto on social media, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is skyrocketing.
⑤ Denial phase: prices start falling, but everyone says, “It’s a healthy correction—a chance to buy in.”
⑥ Panic phase: prices crash again and again, and cries of capitulation are everywhere—and this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean to Pay for a Blockchain’s Fuel?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more everyone competes to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of gas).

【Why it’s related to token prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain transactions late at night or when the market is quiet. The same transaction can cost half as much.

ETH is down 51.5% from its ATH, and many people immediately translate that into “time to buy the dip.” After watching several market cycles, my view is this: a drawdown is a price outcome, not a measure of business value. ETH is down 0.3% over the past 24 hours and 2.3% over the past 7 days, while trading volume remains active and bulls and bears continue to exchange positions.

The delay to Glamsterdam testing matters more. The security team identified 13 real-world contract scenarios, and the new gas rules could cause failed operations to be recorded permanently, so developers have paused. In practice, DeFi protocols, wallets, and L2s will need to redo their compatibility reviews; the four-minute finality proposal, meanwhile, could reduce the settlement funds tied up by payment providers. Faster transactions bring benefits, but security comes at a cost. It’s clear who benefits and who pays.

China’s policy priorities remain stabilizing domestic demand, upgrading industry, and developing digital infrastructure. Opportunities in A-shares are more concentrated in areas that genuinely improve efficiency, such as AI, industrial software, and payment technology. The same goes for Web3: on-chain payments and RWAs are only businesses if they generate real settlement and risk-control revenue. The more the economy emphasizes real efficiency, the less investors can afford to bet on narratives alone. If ETH delivers on security and four-minute finality, payment services will benefit first; if it doesn’t, the story won’t keep users. Do you think this can really be delivered, and who will be the first to pay for it?

Ethereum Postpones Glamsterdam Upgrade Due to Security Concerns! Here Are the Details

Eth developers have decided to postpone the Glamsterdam upgrade, scheduled for Oct 26 on the Hoodi testnet, due to sec concerns. The decision was reportedly made to allow for a more thorough exam of potential technical risks that could affect how smart contracts operate
The delay is based on concerns that changes to how gas costs are calculated on the Eth network could lead to unexpected results in existing smart contracts
It is considered that the error handling mechanisms of smart contracts may operate differently than the current system, especially in the event that gas fees run out
In an assessment published on Oct 13, blockchain security company ChainSecurity pointed out that the combined implementation of EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 proposals could pose some technical risks

According to the company, the simultaneous implementation of the two Eth Improvement Proposals could alter error handling outcomes in the event of gas resource depletion during calls between smart contracts

This situation may cause existing smart contracts to react differently than previously anticipated under certain conditions

Eth developers have chosen to revise the upgrade schedule to allow for a more detailed assessment of potential issues during the testnet phase
No new date has yet been announced for the rollout of the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi test network

The decision to postpone doesn’t mean the upgrade has been cancelled entirely. Current statements indicate that developers aim to dedicate more time to security reviews before rollout

In the Eth ecosystem, network upgrades are important not only for implementing new technical features but also for maintaining compatibility with existing smart contracts

Only 5% of Swedes used cash for their most recent purchase—the Riksbank has revived the debate over an electronic krona (e-krona): either make the krona digital, or lose ground to stablecoins and the digital euro.

Deputy Governor Per Jansson put it plainly to Reuters: if the krona has no usable digital form once cash is digitized, it may struggle to compete with more convenient cross-border payment tools. The central bank has not decided whether to issue one, but it has asked parliament to begin preparing legislation now—because building the system will take at least five years.

Two signals are worth noting: 1) The central bank acknowledges that foreign-currency stablecoins could weaken demand for the domestic currency: “The risk is low for now, but there is a long-term threat”; 2) The e-krona proposal would support offline payments, serving as a backup during power or internet outages. CBDCs are being treated as part of the payment infrastructure, not as speculative assets.

For ordinary users: a CBDC is not an “official coin” and won’t appreciate in value. It competes with Alipay and stablecoins for payment business. The global race among central banks to develop CBDCs is accelerating (the digital euro could launch in 2029), and regulated stablecoins may end up among the biggest beneficiaries.

一、ETH市场走势分析

以太坊在十月二十三日亚洲时段报二千四百零七美元，过去二十四小时微跌约百分之零点三。价格近期在二千三百八十至二千四百一十美元区间内反复震荡，未能有效突破上方阻力。从小时K线来看，最近五个交易时段呈现出小幅波动格局，最高触及二千四百一十三美元后回落，最低下探至二千三百九十一美元。整体走势相对疲软，缺乏明确的方向性突破。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日移动平均线报二千四百零三美元，二十五日均线报二千三百九十八美元，九十九日均线则高居二千四百二十七美元。短期均线虽然略有上翘，但价格仍远低于长期均线，表明中期下行趋势尚未扭转。指数移动平均线显示七日EMA为二千四百零二美元，二十五日EMA为二千四百零七美元，价格与短期均线基本持平，处于方向选择的关键时刻。

MACD指标当前读数为负五点八九，信号线为负九点零五，柱状图为正三点一六。MACD线虽然仍位于零轴下方，但柱状图持续为正值，暗示空头力量有所减弱，短期内存在技术性反弹的可能。RSI六周期报四十四点九三，十二周期报四十五点二五，均处于中性区域，既未超买也未超卖，市场处于观望状态。

布林带上轨为二千四百一十八美元，中轨为二千三百九十六美元，下轨为二千三百七十四美元。价格目前运行在中轨与上轨之间，波动区间相对狭窄。ATR指标报十六点零三，显示市场波动率处于较低水平。KDJ指标中K值为五十八点八五，D值为六十三点一四，J值为五十点二八，三线呈现向下拐头迹象，短期动能偏弱。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重压力。美国现货以太坊ETF在十月二十二日录得一点一零六亿美元的净流出，延续了数周以来的机构抛售趋势。与此同时，以太坊Glamsterdam升级因EIP杠八零三七相关的安全风险而被推迟，原定于十月二十六日在Hoodi测试网的激活计划被迫搁置，给市场发展路线图蒙上了一层阴影。

不过，链上数据显示部分鲸鱼地址在价格回调至二千三百八十美元附近时开始逢低吸纳，某休眠九年半的地址在近期向交易所存入了三千枚ETH后，市场出现了约一点五五亿美元的鲸鱼买入行为，为价格提供了一定的技术支撑。综合指标显示空头信号占比百分之六十六点七，多头信号仅占百分之二十六点七，整体市场情绪偏向谨慎。投资者需要关注二千三百八十美元支撑位的有效性，以及升级推迟对长期基本面的影响。

热门代币方面，今日表现突出的包括SOPH，当前价格零点零零一八三美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十九点六；BMT报价零点零二四七六美元，涨幅百分之十四点六；ERA价格零点零七五七美元，涨幅百分之十二点一。这些代币的逆势表现为市场注入了一定的活跃度。

📰 What exactly is Sweden’s central bank trying to do? Why reconsider the digital krona?

Sweden’s central bank recently made a major move, recommending that the government reassess whether to issue a digital krona (e-krona). The reason is simple: foreign-currency stablecoins and the EU’s digital euro are becoming increasingly competitive. If Swedes start relying widely on digital payments while Sweden’s own digital currency fails to keep up, the krona could eventually lose its place in the payments landscape. Note that no final decision has been made on whether to issue one—they simply think it’s time to study the matter more closely. Source: Binance Square

Why does this news matter?
This isn’t just an internal central bank discussion. It reflects the collision of two major trends: the rise of digital currencies and stablecoins worldwide, and the cautious exploration of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs). Sweden, a pioneer in digital payments where cash is still usable, offers insight into how developed countries are balancing domestic monetary sovereignty with the convenience of international payments amid the digital wave. The fundamental question is: As digital payments become mainstream, could a country’s currency be gradually marginalized in cross-border payments if it lacks a digital form?

Market impact
From a market perspective, this news is currently more likely to affect sentiment than to trigger direct changes in capital flows. What does that mean? Investors may start paying more attention to the possibility that Europe’s—and eventually the world’s—payment systems could see a more diverse competitive landscape for digital currencies. Specifically in crypto, if the digital euro (Euro CBDC) develops rapidly, it could divert some demand from the US dollar payment system. This might exert slight medium- to long-term pressure on dollar-denominated cryptocurrencies such as BTC and ETH, but it is by no means a decisive factor. Historical examples offer a useful reference: in early 2024, expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts were priced in ahead of time, yet the market response was relatively muted. This also shows that a single factor rarely changes the broader trend.

Trading perspective
At this point, this news offers little direct guidance for trading BTC or ETH. The market is more likely to view it as an early signal of changes in competition among macro-level payment systems. If clearer signals emerge from regulators in the future—for example, if widespread adoption of the digital euro changes the currency mix used in cross-border payments—that would be worth watching. In short, sentiment matters in the short term and trends in the long term; this news alone is not a clear basis for buying or selling.

content:
📰 瑞典央行到底想干什么？为啥要重新考虑数字克朗？

瑞典央行最近放了个大招，建议政府重新评估要不要发行数字克朗（e-krona）。理由很简单：现在市面上各种外币稳定币和欧盟的数字欧元太能打，要是瑞典老百姓开始普遍用数字支付，但瑞典自己的货币电子版跟不上，那瑞典克朗在支付领域长期可能就凉凉了。注意，他们还没最终决定到底发不发呢，只是觉得得赶紧研究研究。据 Binance Square

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻不是简单的央行内部讨论，背后是两大趋势的碰撞：一是全球数字货币和稳定币的崛起，二是传统央行数字货币（CBDC）的谨慎探索。瑞典作为数字货币先行者（现在还能用现金），他们的思考代表了发达国家在数字化浪潮中如何平衡本土货币主权与国际支付便利性。本质问题是：当数字支付成为主流，一个国家货币的数字形态缺失，会不会导致它在跨境支付领域逐渐被边缘化？

对市场的影响
从市场角度看，这个新闻目前更像是情绪层面的影响，而不是直接的资金流向变化。这意味着什么？意味着投资者会关注到，未来欧洲乃至全球的支付体系，可能会出现更多元化的数字货币竞争格局。具体到币圈，数字欧元（Euro CBDC）如果发展迅速，可能会分流一部分对美元支付体系的需求，这对美元计价的加密货币（比如 BTC 和 ETH）的中长期可能构成一点微弱的压制，但绝不是决定性因素。参考历史，比如 2024 年初美联储降息预期被提前消化，市场反应相对平淡，也说明了单一因素很难改变大趋势。

操作思路
这个新闻目前看，对 BTC 和 ETH 的直接操作指导意义不大。市场更多会把它看作是宏观支付体系竞争格局演变的早期信号。如果未来监管层面出现更明确的信号（比如数字欧元大规模推广导致跨境支付货币篮子变化），那才是值得关注的点。简单来说，短期看情绪，长期看趋势，这个新闻本身还不能构成明确的买卖依据。

ETH upgrade delay does not mean scaling has failed｜State costs still need validation｜Stay disciplined around 2,400

My stance is cautiously neutral. I won’t treat a testnet delay as a mainnet incident, nor dress it up as a reason to buy the dip. The Ethereum Foundation’s official announcement on October 22 was specific: Glamsterdam, originally scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, has been postponed, with no new date set. The plan to raise Hoodi’s gas limit to 200 million at the same time was also withdrawn. At the ACDE meeting, developers chose to continue investigating how EIP-8037 interacts with existing mainnet smart contracts. The key terms here are “testnet scheduling” and “compatibility investigation”—not a mainnet rollback, and certainly not a reduction in Ethereum’s current mainnet gas limit.

Why do I think this is more worth watching than the ETH price alone? EIP-8037 aims to meter state growth separately, including account creation, contract code, and new storage. The proposal explains that if block gas capacity is increased without adjusting the cost of creating state, node state data could grow faster, potentially increasing hardware demands on ordinary validators. But a new fee model could also change contract deployment costs, gas estimates for complex transactions, and the conditions under which transactions fail. The Foundation has therefore asked application developers to check contracts that rely on fixed gas allowances and validate them on a testnet. If the investigation finds that a small number of widely used contracts are incompatible, delaying the rollout to revise the rules would better serve the network’s long-term reliability than pushing ahead on a fixed date. Conversely, the delay also means that expected throughput improvements and fee experiences cannot be treated as already delivered.

The market’s reaction should be considered separately from the facts. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,402, trading between $2,357 and $2,416 over the past 24 hours. The current price is far from the old “breakout above $2,500” topic still displayed on Plaza; I won’t use that label to create the false impression of a current breakout. Farside’s figures show net outflows of about $110.6 million from U.S. ETH funds on the 22nd. That is subscription and redemption data from the previous trading day; it does not prove that fund flows caused every minute of today’s selling, nor that the delay alone caused the decline. In trading, first watch whether 2,416 can be convincingly reclaimed, then whether support at 2,378 and 2,357 is broken in succession.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now and only consider a small spot long if specific conditions are met. I’d enter with 2% of my total capital only if the one-hour candle closes above $2,416 and price subsequently retests above $2,400 without breaking below it. The initial targets would be $2,450 and then $2,490; I’d sell half at the first target and close the rest at the second, without treating $2,500 as a guaranteed destination. After entry, I’d set a stop-loss if price falls back to $2,385. If it breaks below $2,378 first, I’d cancel the long plan entirely; and if it falls below $2,357, I wouldn’t blindly average down on the way lower. If a subsequent Foundation announcement confirms broader compatibility issues, or price breaks the supports above on rising volume, I’d abandon my current view that this is something that can be waited out, and remain on the sidelines. A small position and clearly defined exit conditions matter more than guessing the upgrade date.

我的态度是谨慎中性，不把测试网延期当成主网事故，也不把它包装成低价捡筹码的理由。以太坊基金会10月22日的正式公告说得很具体：原定10月26日在Hoodi测试网启用的Glamsterdam已推迟，新日期尚未设定；连同当时计划把Hoodi gas上限提高至2亿的安排也一并撤下。开发者在ACDE会议上选择继续调查EIP-8037与现有主网智能合约的交互。这里的关键词是“测试网排期”和“兼容性调查”，不是主网发生回滚，更不是以太坊现在把主网gas上限降了。

为什么我认为这比单看ETH价格更值得注意？EIP-8037试图把创建账户、合约代码和新存储等状态增长单独计量。提案解释，若只提高区块gas容量却不调整状态创建成本，节点状态数据增长可能加快，普通验证者的硬件压力也可能上升；但新的收费方式又可能改变合约部署、复杂交易的gas估算和失败边界。基金会因此要求应用开发者检查依赖固定gas额度的合约，并在测试网验证。若调查发现少数常用合约不兼容，延后修规则比按日期硬推更符合长期网络可靠性。反过来，延迟也意味着预期中的吞吐改善和费用体验不能提前当成已经兑现。

translatedData.content:
This week’s market in one sentence: bullish news piled up like a mountain, prices took a roller-coaster ride, then ended up right where they started.

Bitcoin opened Monday at 80,814, climbed steadily to a weekly high near 84,500 on Wednesday, then slid all the way back on Thursday and Friday, closing Friday at 81,486. On paper, it gained 0.8% for the week. But after all that—up 5%, then down 4%—anyone who bought the top was left holding the bag. It spent the week grinding between 80,672 and 84,808, only to finish as if it hadn’t gone up at all.

Ethereum rose from 2,336 to 2,399, up 2.7% for the week, but failed twice to hold above the 2,500 mark. Solana climbed from 100.75 to 104.19, up 3.4%. It had a big moment this week: the Alpenglow upgrade officially went live on October 21, making it faster. BNB was the strongest of the major coins, rising from 706 to 744, up 5.3% for the week. Its 37th quarterly burn destroyed 1.64 million tokens. ZEC gained over 15% in a week on expectations for the NU7 upgrade in November, making it the only real outlier this week. Price data above is from CoinGecko.

Money is hiding in Bitcoin. Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in about $1.07 billion over the first three days of the week, their strongest run in nearly a month. But the gains weren’t shared around: Ethereum’s ETHA saw $128 million in outflows on Monday and Tuesday, while spot XRP ETFs recorded their first weekly outflows in three months. Bitcoin dominance climbed to its highest level since May. Nobody wants altcoins; money is only interested in Bitcoin. The fund-flow figures are from fool.com’s market updates on the 21st and 22nd, while the XRP figure comes from bitcoininsider’s weekly roundup.

And there was no shortage of good news this week. On October 19, Nasdaq-listed SharpLink announced it would put $400 million in ETH into Ether.fi and Lido to earn staking yield. On the same day, Germany’s Savings Banks Finance Group began offering trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana, and Polygon through its banking app. It serves 50 million customers and is starting with a pilot at five banks. JPMorgan included Bitcoin in its long-term forecasts for the first time, projecting an annualized return of 10%. The final rules for the U.S. GENIUS stablecoin law were also approved. There was so much bullish news you could hold meetings about it all week, yet prices finished their roller-coaster ride right back where they started.

Small caps put on a three-act pump-and-dump show this week. AGT rose 273% in seven days, then fell 31% in a day; DOOD gained 67.7% in seven days, then dropped 17.3% in a day; ALT inexplicably jumped 24% on Wednesday, then plunged 34.5% on Thursday, with 240 million tokens still due to unlock on October 26. Same script every time: quietly pump the price, wait for retail to pile in, then dump the tokens. My market posts this week happened to cover all three. My hands were shaking as I wrote them—I was genuinely worried someone would read the posts and chase the pump.

This week taught us retail investors just one thing: good news doesn’t guarantee price gains. There were bullish rumors everywhere about institutions piling in and banks opening the gates, while our accounts kept asking, “Why is it down again?” The very days packed with the most bullish news were the same days Bitcoin slid from 84,500. What the market lacks isn’t a story—it’s buyers. On bitcoininsider’s weekly recap, on-chain analyst Darkfost wrote that Binance’s stablecoin reserves had fallen to a one-year low. There’s no ammo left.

My view is simple: next week will probably be more range-bound grinding between 81,000 and 85,000. Leave altcoins alone for now. The more bullish news there is, the more you need to keep your hands in check—every pump is waiting for someone to hold the bag. A turnaround will come either when liquidity returns or when Bitcoin genuinely breaks above 85,000. Until then, holding Bitcoin and sitting tight beats chasing any small-cap coin.

Was your account up or down this week? Drop a number in the comments and let me see I’m not the only one losing money.

#BTC #ETH #比特币 #行情复盘 #web3

—— Kai, a retail crypto investor
Disclaimer: These are purely my personal views and do not constitute investment advice. Crypto is extremely risky—only play with money you can afford to lose.

本周行情一句话：利好堆成山，价格坐了趟过山车又回到原地。

大饼周一开在 80814，周三一路摸到 84500 附近的一周高点，周四周五又全滑回来，周五收在 81486。账面上一周涨 0.8%，但中间这波先涨 5% 再跌 4% 的折腾，追高的人基本都站了岗。全周在 80672 到 84808 之间磨，磨完跟没涨一样。

以太从 2336 涨到 2399，周涨 2.7%，但 2500 这个坎两次都没站住。Solana 从 100.75 涨到 104.19，涨 3.4%，这周它有件大事：Alpenglow 升级 10 月 21 日正式上线，速度更快了。BNB 是主流里最硬的，从 706 涨到 744，周涨 5.3%，第 37 次季度销毁烧掉了 164 万颗。ZEC 靠着 11 月 NU7 升级的预期，一周涨超 15%，算是这周唯一的异类。以上价格数据来自 CoinGecko。

钱在往大饼里躲。比特币现货 ETF 这周前三天吸了约 10.7 亿美元，是近一个月最猛的一波。但雨露没均沾：以太坊的 ETHA 周一周二就流出 1.28 亿美元，XRP 现货 ETF 出现三个月来的第一次周度流出。比特币主导率爬到 5 月以来的最高点。山寨没人要，钱只认大饼。资金流这组数引自 fool.com 21 号和 22 号的盘面跟踪，XRP 那条出自 bitcoininsider 的周度汇总。

而这周的利好是真不少。10 月 19 日，纳斯达克上市公司 SharpLink 宣布把 4 亿美元 ETH 投入 Ether.fi 和 Lido 赚质押收益；同一天，德国储蓄银行集团开始在银行 App 里开放比特币、以太坊、XRP、Solana、Polygon 交易，背后是 5000 万客户，先从 5 家银行试点。摩根大通第一次把比特币写进长期预测，给出年化 10%。美国稳定币法案 GENIUS 的最终规则也批了。利好开会都开不完，价格坐完过山车回到原地。

小币这周上演了三出拉盘砸盘连续剧。AGT 七天涨 273% 之后一天跌 31%；DOOD 七天涨 67.7% 之后一天跌 17.3%；ALT 周三无缘无故涨 24%，周四直接跌 34.5%，10 月 26 日还有 2.4 亿枚等着解锁。剧本一模一样：悄悄拉盘，等散户追进去，再集中出货。我这周的盘面帖正好追了这三个，写的时候手都在抖，真怕有人看完就去追。

这周对我们散户只讲了一件事：利好兑现不了涨幅。机构进场、银行开闸的小作文满天飞，账户里却是"怎么又跌了"。利好最密集的那几天，恰恰是大饼从 84500 滑下来的那几天。市场缺的不是故事，是买盘：链上分析师 Darkfost 在 bitcoininsider 的本周复盘里写到，币安的稳定币储备降到了一年最低，没子弹了。

我的观点很直接：下周大概率还是 81000 到 85000 的区间磨，山寨先别碰。利好越密集的时候越要管住手，每一波拉盘都在等接盘的人。转机要么等流动性回来，要么等大饼真站上 85000。在那之前，拿着大饼躺平，比追任何小币都强。

这周你的账户是红是绿？评论区报个数，让我看看我不是一个人在亏。

title: Ethereum перенёс тест обновления. Владельцам ETH переживать?
subTitle:
Когда держишь монету, заголовок «обновление отложили» читать неприятно. Особенно если и так давно ждёшь роста.
Но давайте разберёмся, что случилось.
22 октября Ethereum Foundation объявила о переносе обновления Glamsterdam в тестовой сети Hoodi. Его собирались запустить 26 октября, но новую дату пока не назначили. Разработчикам нужно дополнительно проверить, как предлагаемые изменения будут взаимодействовать с уже существующими смарт-контрактами. 
Проще говоря: перед внедрением новых правил нужно убедиться, что программы, которые работали по старым, продолжат работать правильно.
Что это значит для нас?
Речь идёт о переносе тестового запуска. Из этой новости нельзя делать вывод, что Ethereum остановился или что средства держателей ETH были взломаны.
А вот ожидание обновления действительно затягивается. И тем, кто покупал монету в расчёте на быстрый рост перед конкретной датой, придётся пересмотреть свои ожидания.
Мой взгляд: перенос неприятен, но спешка здесь была бы хуже.
Я бы предпочёл подождать, чем увидеть запуск по расписанию, после которого разработчики экстренно исправляют проблемы. При этом сам факт проверки тоже не повод кричать: «Теперь ETH точно вырастет!»
Для цены важно, появится ли спрос на монету. Даже удачное обновление не гарантирует зелёные свечи.
Сейчас я бы следил за тремя вещами:
— Как именно разработчики решат найденную проблему.
— Когда назначат новый тест и как он пройдёт.
— Будет ли спрос на ETH поддерживать цену после новостей.
Покупать только потому, что «скоро обновление», — слабый план. Продавать только из-за слова «перенос» — тоже.
А вы как относитесь к таким задержкам: спокойно ждёте или каждый перенос уменьшает доверие к проекту? 👇

translatedData.content:
On the afternoon of October 22, UTC+8, on-chain monitoring account Whale Alert reported a notable transfer: 80,000 $ETH (about $194 million) moved out of Binance to an address labeled Binance Beacon Deposit—the entry point Binance uses for Ethereum staking deposits. TokenPost and EconoTimes followed up the same day, while Chinese-language news briefs also described it as a “Binance Beacon deposit.”

Put simply, this wasn’t coins being sent to just any cold wallet; they were moved into a staking channel. ETH received by a Beacon deposit address typically enters the validator staking process, making it harder to sell on the spot market in the short term. Some on-chain observers said the address carries a Beacon Depositor label, suggesting it is more likely staking inventory for the exchange itself than a large holder exiting by withdrawing funds.

For $ETH, another roughly 49,000 ETH of the same kind flowed in two days earlier; this 80,000-ETH transfer is larger. The market is still hovering around $81,000–$82,000, and trading volume is relatively subdued, making large transfers toward staking more likely to attract attention. What gets locked up is expected liquidity—not a button that immediately rewrites prices.

#ETH #币安 #质押  does not constitute investment advice.

Three central banks are now part of the same working group: on the 23rd, the central banks of Malaysia and Thailand joined the BLOOM digital currency initiative led by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, becoming policy members.

BLOOM (Borderless, Liquid, Open, Online, Multi-currency) brings together regulators, financial institutions, and payment networks to focus on three areas: cross-border acceptance and settlement, interoperability between different digital currency systems, and “programmable compliance”—such as automated sanctions screening and identity verification. Participants include around 24 organizations, including JPMorgan Chase, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Visa, Stripe, Temasek, and the World Bank.

What this means for everyday users: 1) “Instant, multi-currency” cross-border transfers are moving from white papers to pilots, with Southeast Asia as the first testing ground; 2) regulated stablecoins and tokenized deposits are the main vehicles, and institutional demand for compliant stablecoins is likely to grow; 3) the focus is on infrastructure, so don’t treat this as a short-term hype catalyst for any coin.

What to watch next: BLOOM’s first cross-border settlement pilot, and whether Hong Kong, Japan, and others will join.

#Stablecoins #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Out Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Seasoned Traders Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly trading in and out,
until fees and volatility wear down their capital.

In fact, staying out of the market is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t make sense of the market, stay out,
Stay out of the market when bulls and bears are battling, and after a string of bad trades—money saved in these three moments
can add up to more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital ready, and you’ll have bullets when opportunity comes. Save your powder.

In terms of moving averages, the 7-period moving average is at $2,405.6, the 25-period moving average at $2,398.3, and the 99-period moving average at $2,427.8. The MACD indicator shows the DIFF line at -6.23, the signal line at -9.90, and the histogram at a positive 3.67. For RSI, the 6-period RSI is 51.57, the 12-period RSI is 48.07, and the 24-period RSI is 45.84. The upper Bollinger Band is at $2,419, the middle band at $2,397, and the lower band at $2,374. The price is trading above the middle band and close to the upper band. Notably, the composite signal factor shows that 9 of 15 factors are bullish, 4 are bearish, and 2 are neutral, putting the long signal ratio at 60%. 以太坊市场深度分析：ETF流出叠加技术面延迟，短期承压但链上支撑犹在

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间二零二六年十月二十三日，以太坊现货价格报二千四百零九美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点八四，跌幅略大于比特币。盘中价格最低触及二千三百九十二美元，随后反弹至二千四百一十二美元附近，整体在二千三百九十至二千四百一十美元区间内窄幅震荡。

从小时K线来看，最近五个交易时段的走势呈现小幅波动格局。开盘价从二千四百一十美元逐步下探至二千三百九十二美元后企稳，随后温和反弹。成交量方面，下跌时段成交额约为一千三百三十四万美元，反弹时段成交量有所下降，显示市场整体交投清淡，多空双方均缺乏明确的进攻意愿。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线位于二千四百零五点六美元，二十五周期均线位于二千三百九十八点三美元，九十九周期均线位于二千四百二十七点八美元。短期均线已经走平并略有上翘，但长期均线仍然高悬于价格上方，形成一定压力。价格目前运行在短期均线上方但低于长期均线，呈现典型的震荡整理形态。

MACD指标显示DIFF线位于负六点二三，信号线位于负九点九零，柱状线为正值三点六七。与比特币类似，以太坊MACD同样处于零轴下方但柱状线持续为正且逐步收窄，空头动能正在减弱，短期存在修复需求。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为五十一点五七，十二周期RSI为四十八点零七，二十四周期RSI为四十五点八四。短周期RSI刚刚回到五十上方，显示短期买盘略有恢复，但中长周期RSI仍处于偏弱区域，整体动能不够强劲。

布林带上轨位于二千四百一十九美元，中轨位于二千三百九十七美元，下轨位于二千三百七十四美元。价格在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，布林带开口较窄，表明短期波动率处于低位，市场正在等待新的催化剂来打破僵局。

值得关注的是，综合信号因子显示十五个因子中有九个看涨、四个看跌、两个中性，做多比例达到百分之六十。与比特币不同的是，以太坊综合指标最终给出的是做多信号，胜率高达百分之七十八点九五，表明量化模型对以太坊短期反弹的信心更强。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的基本面环境较为复杂。利空方面，现货ETF在十月二十二日录得一点一零六亿美元净流出，机构资金持续撤离对价格形成压制。同时，Glamsterdam硬分叉在Hoodi测试网上的部署被推迟，引发了社区对网络安全性和升级时间表的担忧。此外，一个沉寂九点五年的 dormant 钱包向交易所存入了三千枚以太坊，增加了潜在的卖压预期。

利好方面同样不容忽视。链上数据显示，有鲸鱼将一千九百一十七枚比特币轮换为六万四千五百四十五枚以太坊，这种大规模的资金轮动表明部分大户对以太坊的中长期价值仍然看好，正在逢低吸纳。同时以太坊网络链上交易量依然活跃，生态基本面保持稳健。

从市场情绪来看，以太坊的跌幅虽然略大于比特币，但技术面信号反而更为积极。综合指标给出做多信号且胜率接近百分之七十九，这在当前整体偏弱的环境中显得尤为突出。建议投资者关注二千三百八十美元至二千四百美元区间的支撑有效性，上方阻力位看二千四百二十七美元至二千四百三十四美元。若硬分叉消息面明朗化，以太坊有望迎来一波修复行情。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What's More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what was your rationale?), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover that your losses
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, constantly reversing your position right after getting stopped out,
or constantly failing to let winning trades run.

Market conditions change, but your behavioral patterns won't change on their own unless you pay attention and work on them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trade records.

Hey, everyone! To those of you hoping to turn your lives around overnight in crypto, let me share my own experience. I’m not trying to encourage anyone to get carried away.

You see my account nearing ten million, but it took years of grinding to get here. You didn’t see how badly I lost in the years before that: I was blindly overconfident, refused to admit when I was wrong, and kept thinking I could make it all back in one trade. Instead, I sank deeper and deeper until I had to sell my house to pay off my debts.

At my lowest point, my hands would shake whenever I opened the trading app. My account balance shrank every day, but I kept telling myself to wait a little longer. In the end, it all went to zero. Later, I started over with a few tens of thousands raised from friends and family. I completely gave up on getting rich quick, stuck to the rules, and built up my positions slowly. That’s how I managed to climb back.

I’ve condensed ten years of painful lessons into ten points:
First, when the broader market plunges, keep a close eye on the few coins that hold up. The real leaders often emerge amid panic.
Second, don’t overcomplicate trading. Understanding the major trend is more useful than piling on a dozen indicators.
Third, if a short-term trade goes wrong, admit it. A 5% loss is a scrape; a 50% loss can leave you trapped for good.
Fourth, don’t rush to buy the dip during a crash. Don’t try to catch a falling knife—wait for the price to stop falling and stabilize before you enter.
Fifth, money always flows toward strength, and leading coins are often stronger than you expect.
Sixth, don’t be tempted by cheap coins. A coin that’s down 90% can still fall another 90%.
Seventh, a winning streak is when you’re most at risk. Many people don’t get wiped out in a bear market—they get overconfident after making money, take on oversized positions, and crash.
Eighth, if you’re not confident, stay out of the market. Staying on the sidelines doesn’t lose you money; one reckless, oversized position can be fatal.
Ninth, with new coins, watch the hype but don’t get involved. The faster they heat up, the faster they can collapse.
Tenth, always respect the market. It has a way of humbling the arrogant and defiant.
#ETH 
I’ve come to understand one thing: in a bull market, everyone feels like a genius. It’s the bear market that shows who really knows how to trade. Making money isn’t the real skill—being able to walk away with it intact is. Staying alive will always matter more than making a quick buck.@Square-Creator-cb3052992550a

🐳 3,000 ETH that had been asleep for 9.5 years woke up—and after a 128x gain, it went to an exchange

Last night, on-chain monitoring account Ember (EmberCN) flagged a transfer with quite a story behind it:

🔹 In 2017, 3,000 ETH were withdrawn from Gemini, when ETH was around $19, for a total value of about $56,000
🔹 The address then lay dormant for about 9.5 years, with no activity
🔹 On the evening of October 22, the ETH was transferred to Kraken. At the time, it was worth about $7.23 million—a gain of roughly 128x over 9.5 years

Most of the reactions in the comments were envious, but I think there are a couple more things worth noticing.

First, buying at the right time isn’t hard; holding on is. Plenty of people bought ETH at $19 in 2017. Very few made it through several brutal bear markets without cashing out after a double or panic-selling during a crash. Many people didn’t fail to make money—they made it, then gave it back.

Second, transferring funds to an exchange doesn’t mean they’ve been sold. Some people pointed out in the replies that the blockchain shows a deposit, not a trade. It could be a sale, or a change of custody, or collateralization. Don’t automatically treat it as a “whale dumping” signal. In today’s market, 3,000 ETH is nowhere near enough to change the trend.

Third, keeping a wallet untouched for 9.5 years and still safeguarding its private keys and backups is an achievement in itself. If it were you, could you still open your 2017 wallet today?

My take: the real lesson isn’t “buy early.” It’s to use money you can afford to leave untouched from the start, set a rule not to touch it, and keep your wallet secure enough to recover even ten years later.

What’s the coin you’ve held the longest, and for how long? Did you ever come close to selling along the way? Let’s talk in the comments 👇

content:
🐳 睡了9年半的3000枚ETH醒了，128倍之后它去了交易所

昨晚链上监测账号余烬（EmberCN）报了一笔很有故事感的转账：

🔹 2017年从Gemini提出3000枚ETH，当时ETH约19美元，总价值约5.6万美元
🔹 这个地址休眠了约9年半，一直没动
🔹 10月22日晚，这批ETH转进了Kraken，按当时价格约723万美元，9年半涨了约128倍

评论区最多的反应是羡慕，但我觉得这件事值得多看两层。

第一，买对不难，拿住才难。2017年19美元买ETH的人不少，能扛过中间几轮大熊市、不在翻倍时下车、不在暴跌时割肉的，才是极少数。很多人不是没赚到钱，是赚到过又还回去了。

第二，转进交易所不等于已经卖了。有人在回复里专门提醒，链上只能看到充值，看不到成交。可能是卖出，也可能是换托管、做抵押，别直接把它当成"巨鲸砸盘"信号。3000枚ETH放在今天的市场里，量也远不到能改变走势的程度。

第三，9年半不动，私钥和备份能一直保管好，这本身就是本事。换成你，2017年的钱包今天还打得开吗？

我的看法：真正值得学的不是"早买"，而是一开始就用闲钱、定好不碰的规则，再把钱包安全做到十年后还能找回来。

Established exchanges are joining forces to “besiege” prediction markets: CME and other commodity exchanges are pressuring the CFTC to reject Kalshi’s proposal for perpetual crude oil futures, citing risks to market integrity.

The point of contention is the “perpetual contract” product structure. It originated in crypto markets, has no expiration date, and uses funding rates to maintain its peg. It is a mainstream trading instrument in crypto. Kalshi wants to bring it into the CFTC-regulated commodity market, but traditional exchanges worry this would bypass existing margin, risk-control, and disclosure frameworks.

What this means for ordinary users: 1) If the CFTC approves it, U.S. users will be able to trade perpetual contracts within a compliant framework—a product-level boost for the industry as a whole; 2) If it is rejected, the boundary between prediction markets and traditional futures will become clearer, hampering Kalshi and its peers’ expansion; 3) The range of derivatives available to U.S. users will likely be reshuffled depending on the decision.

What to watch next: when the CFTC responds, and whether Kalshi launches overseas first to sidestep regulation.

Client updates after the Hoodi delay | Older Lodestar versions risk a testnet fork | Watching ETH near $2,400

My stance is to verify infrastructure risks first, then discuss a price rebound. This is not another round of debating whether “the delay is bearish for ETH,” but a follow-up on what node operators actually need to do after the delay. In its October 22 announcement, the Ethereum Foundation canceled the plan to activate Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet at 17:42 UTC on October 26. A new activation time has not yet been set. What was withdrawn was the planned configuration for the execution layer, consensus layer, and 200-million-gas limit—not a rollback of the testnet’s chain history, and certainly not a fork of mainnet. The client table subsequently published by the Foundation lists Lodestar consensus client v1.50.1, Besu execution client 26.10.1, and other versions as corresponding to this delay, while some client entries remain blank. Operators should wait for official guidance from their respective teams.

The most important warning comes from the Lodestar team’s own v1.50.1 release notes: nodes running Hoodi that remain on v1.50.0 will retain the old configuration, which will activate Gloas at the originally scheduled epoch 132352. At that point, they will diverge from the canonical Hoodi chain, and validators may miss their duties until they upgrade and resynchronize. Besu’s 26.10.1 notes also clearly state that the version cancels the planned activation on Hoodi, while noting that operators on networks other than Hoodi can ignore this Besu update, which is specific to the delay. The two client teams’ notices corroborate the Foundation’s announcement, but the affected users and required actions differ, so it would be wrong to simply say, “All ETH holders must upgrade immediately.” Regular mainnet ETH holders do not need to change their testnet node configuration; those operating Hoodi nodes should check whether their execution layer, consensus layer, and validator client have all adopted the delayed configuration.

The mechanism through which this affects the crypto market is the reliability of development and testing, not a direct change to today’s ETH issuance or gas fees. If operators mix old and new configurations, testnet data could become unreliable and, in turn, slow down decisions about the official schedule. If the upgrade goes smoothly, that only means this particular coordination risk has eased; it does not mean a mainnet upgrade date has been confirmed. Kraken’s ETH/USD quote was around $2,401 at the time of writing, with a 24-hour low of about $2,357 and a high of about $2,430. The price has rebounded from its low, but I cannot prove that the client announcements alone drove the move. Around $2,400 is currently just a level to watch; whether ETH can hold above $2,430 would be a clearer dividing line between strength and weakness. If it falls below $2,357 again and continues lower, the short-term stabilization thesis is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay on the sidelines for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long position; I would not make a high-leverage bet on the event. I would only consider entering in two tranches, using no more than 3% of my account, if ETH gets back above $2,430, holds that level on a one-hour retest, and the Foundation does not flag any new compatibility issues. My first target would be $2,470, where I would take half off; my second target would be $2,500, where I would close the rest in stages. If the price falls back below $2,390 after entry, I would immediately stop out. If a new official notice reports a testnet client issue, I would first cancel the plan and assess whether to exit entirely, even if the price has not reached the stop-loss level. No trigger means no trade; a plan must not be presented as if it has already made a profit.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation Hoodi delay announcement and client table; Lodestar v1.50.1 and Besu 26.10.1 release notes. Quote: Kraken ETH/USD. #EthereumHoodiTestnetGlamsterdamHardForkDelayed #ETH

我的态度是先核实基础设施风险，再谈价格反弹。这不是重复讨论“延期会不会利空ETH”，而是跟进延期后节点运营者真正要做的事。以太坊基金会10月22日公告已取消原定10月26日17:42 UTC在Hoodi测试网启动Glamsterdam的安排，新的激活时间尚未确定；撤回的是未来的执行层、共识层与2亿gas上限配置，不是回滚测试网链史，更不是主网已经分叉。基金会随后列出的客户端表中，Lodestar共识层v1.50.1、Besu执行层26.10.1等版本明确对应这次延期，而部分客户端栏位仍空白，运营者应等各自团队正式说明。

最值得警惕的是Lodestar团队自己的v1.50.1发布说明：运行Hoodi的节点若停留在v1.50.0，旧配置仍会在原定epoch 132352激活Gloas，届时会离开Hoodi正确链，验证者可能错过职责，直到升级并重新同步。Besu的26.10.1说明也明确该版本取消Hoodi上的原定激活，同时指出非Hoodi网络运营者可以忽略这次Besu专门更新。两家客户端与基金会公告相互印证，但适用对象和操作不同，不能简单喊“所有ETH持有人必须立刻升级”。普通主网持币者无需为测试网节点配置做操作；运营Hoodi节点的人则应检查执行层、共识层和验证者客户端是否都采纳了撤期配置。

它影响加密市场的机制是开发与测试的可靠性，而非直接改变今日ETH发行量或Gas费。若运营者混用新旧配置，测试网数据可能失真，进而拖慢正式排期判断；若升级顺利，只能说明这一段协调风险降低，不能据此宣布主网升级日期已确定。Kraken的ETH/USD写稿约2401美元，过去24小时低点约2357、高点约2430；价格从低点反弹，但我无法证明这是客户端公告单独推动。当前2400附近只是观察位，2430上方能否稳住才是更明确的强弱分界；若再跌穿2357并延续，短线企稳设想失效。

如果是我自己交易，我暂时观望，方向只考虑现货小仓位多头，不做高杠杆事件赌局。只有ETH重新站上2430美元、回踩一小时不破，且基金会未再提示新的兼容问题，我才试着用账户资金最多3%分两笔参与。第一目标2470美元，触及先减半；第二目标2500美元，剩余部分分批平仓。入场后若跌回2390美元下方，立即止损平仓；若测试网客户端出现新的正式异常通报，即使价格未到止损也先撤销计划、评估是否全数退出。没有触发就没有成交，不能把预案说成已经盈利。

📰 Why are Southeast Asian central banks suddenly teaming up to promote stablecoins? Is the BLOOM initiative really about saving money, or is there more to it?

The central banks of Malaysia and Thailand have joined Singapore in the BLOOM project, a cross-border initiative to promote stablecoins. The initiative claims it can help financial institutions cut costs through coordination, focusing mainly on the cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits. This latest move marks another step forward in regional cooperation on digital currency infrastructure in Asia.

Why does this news matter?
The core value of the BLOOM project lies in addressing two major pain points in cross-border payments: high fees and low efficiency. Southeast Asian economies are highly complementary and trade frequently, but traditional payment costs remain high. In essence, the three central banks are working together to advance a stablecoin-based process of dollarization, making the movement of funds within the region more efficient. This is similar to the idea behind the Federal Reserve's launch of the dollar bank (DOL): both aim to build an offshore dollar system within a specific region, but this initiative uses stablecoins and tokenized deposits as its vehicles. From a regulatory perspective, this is the most substantive cooperation among central banks in the field of digital currency regulation, going far beyond the memorandums of understanding they signed previously.

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC and ETH is relatively limited. The benefits to the stablecoin ecosystem are concentrated mainly in dollar-denominated assets, but the BLOOM project focuses on stablecoins in multiple currencies, so its connection to the prices of major cryptocurrencies is weak. However, if the initiative succeeds, it could divert some demand from traditional cross-border payments over the long term, adding a new competitor to the existing payment system. Historically, when central banks promote a technology, it often boosts short-term sentiment toward related technology assets. But the BLOOM project is still a relatively new experiment, so any short-term market reaction may reflect expectations of greater regional economic integration more than the technology itself.

Trading outlook
This news is broadly neutral to mildly positive for sentiment across the crypto market, but the impact is limited. If the BLOOM project is implemented, it would signal growing acceptance among central banks of cross-border stablecoin use and could provide some support for dollarization. If it attracts more institutions over time, it could accelerate the development of digital currency infrastructure in the region. In the short term, however, BTC and ETH will continue to be driven mainly by the Federal Reserve and domestic economic data, with the BLOOM project serving more as a positive backdrop.

📰 为什么东南亚央行突然组团推稳定币？BLOOM计划是真心省钱还是另有所图？

马来西亚和泰国央行联合新加坡，加入BLOOM项目的跨境稳定币推广计划。这个计划号称能帮金融机构通过协调来节省成本，主要涉及稳定币和代币化存款的跨境使用。这轮行动意味着亚洲区域在数字货币基础设施共建上又往前走了一步。

为什么这条新闻重要？
BLOOM项目的核心价值在于解决跨境支付中的两个痛点：手续费高和效率低。东南亚国家经济互补性强，贸易往来频繁但传统支付成本居高不下。这次三国央行联手，本质是在推动基于稳定币的美元化进程，让区域内资金流转更高效。这与美联储推出美元银行（DOL）的思路类似——都是在特定区域内构建离岸美元体系，但这次是以稳定币和代币化存款为载体。从监管角度看，这是各国央行在数字货币监管领域最实质性的合作，远超之前签署的谅解备忘录。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响比较有限。稳定币生态的利好主要集中在美元计价资产上，但BLOOM计划是以多币种稳定币为主，与加密货币主流价格关联度不高。不过，如果这个计划能成功，长期看会分流部分传统跨境支付需求，相当于给现有支付体系增加了一个新的竞争者。从历史经验看，央行推动某项技术时，往往会带动相关技术资产的短期情绪，但BLOOM项目本身属于较新的探索，市场对其短期反应可能更多来自对区域经济一体化的预期，而非技术本身。

操作思路
这个新闻对加密市场整体情绪偏中性偏利好，但幅度有限。BLOOM计划如果能落地，意味着全球央行对稳定币跨境应用的认可度正在提升，对美元化进程有一定支撑作用。如果后续能吸引更多机构参与，可能推动区域内数字货币基础设施建设加速。但短期内BTC和ETH主要还是受美联储和国内经济数据影响，BLOOM计划更多是作为背景利好存在。

📰 ETF outflows hit $635 million: What exactly happened to Bitcoin this time?

Last Thursday, Bitcoin ETFs saw a major outflow of $635 million in a single day, ending a three-day streak of net inflows. As a result, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded cumulative net outflows of $175 million since the start of October. While this is small compared with the ETFs’ total assets, it is enough to raise concerns about investor confidence.

Why does this matter?
The ETF outflows came after Bitcoin fell below $82,000, meaning that at a particularly vulnerable moment for the market, investors chose to convert their ETF shares into cash. This differs from the past, when ETF outflows often occurred during price uptrends; this time, they came during a downturn. More broadly, this reflects investors’ response to uncertainty in the macroeconomic environment: the Federal Reserve’s restrictive policy remains in place, while Bitcoin, as a highly volatile asset, is among the first to be shunned by investors seeking safety.

Market impact
The immediate impact on BTC and ETH is mainly a short-term hit to sentiment. Cumulative outflows of $175 million since October represent about 2.2% of the overall ETF market. Though the proportion is small, ETF tracking mechanisms mean these outflows correspond to a reduction in spot Bitcoin holdings. If outflows continue to grow, they could create a negative feedback loop: money leaves ETFs → spot Bitcoin holdings decline → ETF valuations come under pressure → more money leaves ETFs. BTC is currently at a key support level of $82,000, and whether it holds will directly determine whether ETFs face a wave of knock-on selling.

Approach
The pressure from current ETF outflows is felt mainly in market sentiment. Historical data show that a single-day outflow of $635 million is moderate to small by the standards of ETF history. However, given the current macroeconomic environment, it may indicate that investors are reassessing their allocations to risk assets. If ETFs continue to see net outflows over the next three days and Bitcoin fails to hold $82,000, investors should be alert to the possibility of an accelerated retreat from ETFs. This assessment would no longer hold if Bitcoin falls below the psychological threshold of $80,000.

📰 ETF大出血6.35亿美元：比特币这次到底怎么了？

上周四比特币ETF遭遇大额资金外流，单日流出6.35亿美元，终止了此前三天的净流入势头。这导致10月份以来美国现货比特币ETF累计净流出1.75亿美元。虽然这个规模相比ETF总规模还算小，但足以引起市场对资金信心的担忧。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次ETF资金流出发生在比特币价格跌破8.2万美元后，意味着在市场最脆弱的时刻，投资者选择将ETF份额换成现金。这与以往不同，因为过去ETF资金流出往往发生在价格上涨通道中，而这次则发生在下跌周期。更深层次看，这是投资者对当前宏观环境不确定性的反应——美联储的紧缩政策仍在持续，而比特币作为高波动资产，首当其冲受到避险资金抛弃。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响主要是短期情绪冲击。10月以来的累计1.75亿美元流出，占整个ETF市场规模约2.2%，虽然比例不大，但考虑到ETF的跟踪机制，这部分资金实际对应着比特币现货的减少。这意味着如果流出继续扩大，将形成负反馈：资金离开ETF → 比特币现货减少 → ETF估值压力 → 更多资金离开ETF。目前BTC价格处于关键支撑位8.2万美元，这个位置能否守住直接决定了ETF是否会出现连锁式抛售。

操作思路
当前ETF流出对市场的压力更多体现在情绪层面。从历史数据看，单日流出6.35亿美元在ETF发展史中属于中低规模，但结合当前宏观环境，可能预示着资金正在重新评估风险资产配置比例。如果未来三天ETF继续净流出，且比特币无法守住8.2万美元，那么需要警惕资金可能加速撤离ETF。这个判断如果跌破8万美元这个心理关口，则逻辑不成立。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, we forget every principle, so I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. Take the money out, and keep your mindset intact.

That’s all five. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year adds up to 12x; earning a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30x over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market;
the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

title: Whale Swaps $159M of Bitcoin for Ether in 11 Days: Is Smart Money Rotating From $BTC to $ETH?
subTitle:
Lookonchain tracked one whale selling 1,917 BTC and buying 64,545 ETH while prices fell. Here's what the rotation could mean, and what it doesn't prove.

🐋 One wallet, 11 days, $159M of Bitcoin turned into Ether. No headline, no announcement, just a steady stream of swaps that on-chain trackers can't stop talking about.
On Thursday, the wallet sold another 246.25 $BTC, worth about $20.64M, and put almost exactly the same amount into 8,286 $ETH. Add up the last 11 days and it has sold 1,917.7 $BTC ($159M) and bought 64,545 $ETH ($155M), according to Lookonchain. The wallet is unnamed, so nobody knows who's behind it.
🔍 The pattern matters more than the size.
Lookonchain first flagged it on October 12, when it sold 229 $BTC ($19.1M) for 7,469.8 $ETH. By the three-day mark, it had swapped 1,074 $BTC ($89.5M) for 36,159 $ETH. These are near dollar-for-dollar swaps spread across days. That looks patient, not panicked, and the money went straight into $ETH, not into stablecoins or the sidelines.
🧠 Why traders care.
Large wallets sometimes move before the crowd does, so people read every swap like a signal. A few other things lined up with it:
Ethereum exchange reserves fell by about 170K $ETH to roughly 14.88M over 48 hours. One whale withdrew 10,954 $ETH ($26.97M) from Kraken and staked it after four months of inactivity, and another pulled 9,000 $ETH ($22.4M) off an exchange and deposited it into Aave. Coins leaving exchanges means less supply ready to be sold, though that alone doesn't prove anyone plans to hold for the long term.
⚠️ Here's what it doesn't prove.
One wallet is one wallet. It tells you what one holder decided, not what the market is doing. Thursday's price action makes that point clearly. $ETH fell about 5.5% and slipped below $2,400, while $BTC dropped about 4%, so the rotation didn't protect $ETH from the selloff.
And the flow isn't one-directional. The same day, Lookonchain reported four new wallets receiving 1,127 $BTC ($93.45M) from Wintermute. Some big money is leaving Bitcoin, and some is arriving.
✅ What this means for you
If you trade $ETH, the key level is the $2,355 support after Thursday's drop. A whale's thesis can take weeks to play out, and your stop doesn't care about it. Size your risk around price, not around one wallet.
If you're on the sidelines, treat this as a lead, not a reason to buy. Whale rotations are easy to see after the fact and hard to profit from by copying.
If you hold $BTC or $ETH long term, the useful lesson is the ratio between them. Watching how $ETH performs against $BTC over time says more than any single wallet.
🟢 Bullish scenario
The rotation continues, exchange reserves keep falling, and $ETH holds the $2,355 area, which lets other large wallets follow and turns one whale's trade into a visible trend.
🔴 Risk scenario
The accumulated $ETH moves to an exchange deposit address, which would flip the story from accumulation to distribution, and $ETH loses $2,355 while the market stays under pressure.
👀 Three things to watch
1️⃣ The $2,355 level
Does $ETH hold it, or does the selloff push through?
2️⃣ Where the 64,545 $ETH goes
Does it stay in the wallet or get staked, or does it show up at an exchange?
3️⃣ Other whales
Do more large wallets copy the rotation, or does this stay a one-wallet story?
💡 The key takeaway
This is a real, consistent rotation from one large wallet, and it lines up with falling $ETH exchange reserves. It's also a sample size of one, and price fell anyway.
The real question isn't whether one whale likes $ETH. It's whether enough other wallets agree to turn a single trade into a trend.

That is the part worth watching.

translatedData.content:
【ETH cuts “finality” to 4 minutes: this time, the narrative is a little different】

CoinDesk reports that a new Ethereum proposal aims to reduce transaction finality time to 4 minutes. If implemented, this would mean transfer and payment providers could make customers wait less than the dozen-plus minutes they do now, reducing the liquidity costs of funds tied up during the wait. The businesses most directly affected would be merchants, custodians, and transfer platforms that rely on fast settlement.

This is more worth thinking about than “Will ETH go up?” ETH’s narrative is shifting from an asset used as collateral toward a public infrastructure that can settle transactions, and the business logic makes sense too: faster confirmation can shorten capital turnover times. But a proposal isn’t a launch, and a launch doesn’t mean merchants will migrate. What I care more about is who bears the cost of the upgrades, and whether users will actually be willing to pay. Hype driven by protocol slogans alone lasts, at most, for a while; for this to become long-term value, we need to see businesses integrating it and using it consistently.

ETH has retraced about half from its ATH. The Fear & Greed Index is at 50, below its weekly average of 57, yet trading volume remains strong. Capital seems to be waiting for direction—or for a reason to believe this will be implemented. Starknet’s research team leaving ETH is also a reminder that the application layer is far from a united front.

My view is that this wave could last anywhere from a few weeks to a quarter. For it to go further, forget the slogans—watch the settlement business. I’ve said it’s nothing magical, but I still get itchy fingers; are you waiting for direction, or are your fingers already itching?

content:
【ETH把“最终确认”压到4分钟：这次叙事有点不一样】

CoinDesk披露，Ethereum新草案瞄准把交易最终确认时间缩短至4分钟。若落地，转账和支付服务商就能少让客户资金等十几分钟，等待占用的流动性成本会下降；最直接受影响的，是依赖快速结算的商户、托管和转账平台。

这比“ETH涨不涨”更值得琢磨。ETH的叙事正从资产抵押品往可结算的公共基础设施挪，商业逻辑也通：更快确认能缩短资金周转。但草案不等于上线，上线也不等于商户迁移。我更关心改造成本由谁承担，用户是否真愿意付费。只靠协议口号炒，最多一阵热度；变成长期价值，得看到业务接入和持续使用。

ETH从ATH回撤约一半，恐惧贪婪指数50、低于周均57，成交量却不冷。资金像在等方向，也像在等落地理由。Starknet研究离开ETH，也提醒大家：应用层没有铁板一块。

我倾向于，这波能持续几周到一季；想走更久，不看口号，看结算生意。说了不神，手还是会痒；你们是在等方向，还是已经手痒了？
